author: Vior_
body: I am interested in any summer DTM tournaments for avicus. I have never been apart of one because I always have school, but I will be available for the summer as my skills have increased and I have more free time. I was wondering if I could join a team for the server. I can fast build and am good at destroying the mon so an invite to a group would be appreciated. I would obviously need to go further into detail but let me know if you are interested. (ignore my k/d ratio if you want to see how good i really am msg me and we can 1v1)
